UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authoritative employee user profile and granular RBAC assignment for Montex Forge MIS.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID matching the document ID.

email.description: Corporate or verified employee email address.

role.description: Canonical granular UserRole enforced at database and application layers.

designation.description: Official job title at Montex Forge.

accountStatus.description: Account lifecycle status. Only active accounts are granted database access.

mustChangePassword.description: Flag indicating whether employee must rotate temporary password on next login.

provisionedBy.description: UID or email of the Super Admin who provisioned the account.

provisionedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when account was provisioned.

permissions.description: Module-level permission map synchronized with canonical role.

isDepartmentHead.description: Flag indicating if employee is an authorized Department Head for task verification and handovers.

managedDepartment.description: Department scope managed by Department Head.

SystemConfigDocument.title: SystemConfigDocument
SystemConfigDocument.description: Singleton system configuration and executive summary documents (dashboardKpis, productionSummary, alertThresholds).

totalOrderBookValue.description: Total active order book value in INR.

monthlyDispatchTargetMT.description: Target monthly dispatch tonnage in MT.

rawMaterialStockMT.description: Total raw material stock in MT.

lowStockAlertsCount.description: Count of raw material grades below reorder threshold.

totalOutstandingINR.description: Total customer receivables outstanding in INR.

overdueReceivablesINR.description: Overdue customer receivables (>90 days) in INR.

Low_Stock_Threshold_Tons.description: Alert threshold for low raw material stock in MT.

Delay_Threshold_Days.description: Alert threshold for order delay in days.

Rejection_Rate_Max_Pct.description: Alert threshold for rejection rate percentage.

Payment_Overdue_Days.description: Alert threshold for payment overdue days.

updatedBy.description: UID of actor who last updated the document.

Customer.title: Customer
Customer.description: Master record for industrial B2B forging customers.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Master catalog record for forged rings, flanges, shafts, and blanks.

OrderJourney.title: OrderJourney
OrderJourney.description: End-to-end Sales Order lifecycle tracking across Inquiry, Forging, Heat Treatment, Machining, Quality, Dispatch, and Invoicing.

fprUid.description: Assigned Focal Point of Responsibility (FPR) user UID.

fprName.description: Assigned FPR full name for customer order coordination.

handoverStage.description: Current inter-department handover gate (H-1 to H-5).

creditHoldOverrideBy.description: CEO/Super Admin who authorized credit hold dispatch override.

creditHoldOverrideReason.description: Mandatory justification for credit hold override.

DispatchConsignmentRecord.title: DispatchConsignmentRecord
DispatchConsignmentRecord.description: Dispatch consignment, transporter vehicle, challan, and delivery tracking record.

RawMaterialStock.title: RawMaterialStock
RawMaterialStock.description: Steel grade billet/ingot inventory balance, reorder level, and valuation.

StockMovement.title: StockMovement
StockMovement.description: Immutable raw material stock ledger transaction (INWARD, ISSUE, RETURN, ADJUSTMENT).

QualityInspectionRecord.title: QualityInspectionRecord
QualityInspectionRecord.description: Metallurgical, NDT (UT/MPI/LPI), hardness, and MTC quality inspection record.

OutstandingAgeingRecord.title: OutstandingAgeingRecord
OutstandingAgeingRecord.description: Sensitive customer invoice receivables and ageing bucket tracker.

ActionQueueItem.title: ActionQueueItem
ActionQueueItem.description: Plant-wide exception alert and action queue item across Inventory, Orders, Quality, and Finance.

AuditLogEntry.title: AuditLogEntry
AuditLogEntry.description: Immutable append-only security and operational audit trail entry.

QuotationRecord.title: QuotationRecord
QuotationRecord.description: Commercial RFQ and customer quotation register (#1 persistent operational register).

contactPerson.description: First-class customer contact person for RFQ.

followUpNotes.description: Full commercial negotiation and follow-up log (non-truncated).

TenderRecord.title: TenderRecord
TenderRecord.description: PSU, railway, defense, and EPC contract tender bid register (#2 persistent operational register).

SteelMillSupplier.title: SteelMillSupplier
SteelMillSupplier.description: Approved steel mill vendor master and vendor rating registry.

primaryGrades.description: Bounded list of approved steel grades (<= 20).

PurchaseOrderRecord.title: PurchaseOrderRecord
PurchaseOrderRecord.description: Steel mill billet/ingot procurement Purchase Order register (#3 persistent operational register).

ShopMachineLog.title: ShopMachineLog
ShopMachineLog.description: Shop floor hydraulic press, ring rolling mill, hammer, and CNC machine utilization log (#4 persistent operational register).

FurnaceBatchLog.title: FurnaceBatchLog
FurnaceBatchLog.description: Reheating and heat treatment furnace batch thermal cycle log (#5 persistent operational register).

MachineMaintenanceTicket.title: MachineMaintenanceTicket
MachineMaintenanceTicket.description: Preventive and breakdown plant equipment maintenance ticket (#6 persistent operational register).

PowerConsumptionLog.title: PowerConsumptionLog
PowerConsumptionLog.description: Plant electrical kWh, PNG gas SCM, and energy intensity per forged MT log (#7 persistent operational register).

DimensionalInspectionReport.title: DimensionalInspectionReport
DimensionalInspectionReport.description: CMM and vernacular caliper dimensional tolerance inspection report (OD, ID, thickness, ovality) (#8 persistent operational register).

JobCostSheet.title: JobCostSheet
JobCostSheet.description: Sensitive order-level manufacturing cost breakdown and margin analysis sheet.

TaskRecord.title: TaskRecord
TaskRecord.description: Central Task, Accountability, Supervisor Verification & SLA Escalation Engine record.

HandoverRecord.title: HandoverRecord
HandoverRecord.description: Dual-custody inter-department stage handover record (H-1 to H-5).

PurchaseRequisitionRecord.title: PurchaseRequisitionRecord
PurchaseRequisitionRecord.description: Raw material and stores Purchase Requisition (PR) with Maker!=Checker approval gate.

NcrCapaRecord.title: NcrCapaRecord
NcrCapaRecord.description: Non-Conformance Report (NCR), Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and Corrective/Preventive Action (CAPA) register.

PaymentFollowUpRecord.title: PaymentFollowUpRecord
PaymentFollowUpRecord.description: Customer receivable collection follow-up and supplier payable tracking log.
